action: Pulls the face and chin down out of the sphere and the neck down below it; brow, nose and mouth area are blocked as planes. Strength 0.300.
why: Big forms first: face plane, jaw, neck.
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes grab downward for jaw and neck, then draw for brow ridge.

action: Carves the eye sockets, draws the nose, pulls the ears out from the side of the head and carves into them.
why: Narration: carve eye sockets, draw nose, pull ears out to carve them.
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes crease (negative) in the sockets, draw for the nose, snake_hook for the ear.

action: Places two eyeball spheres as separate objects (orange selection outline) in the sockets; mouth, lips and nostrils are already sculpted.
why: Narration: sculpt her mouth, her nostrils; her eyes, place them.
reader_equivalent: Add two UV spheres per eye (mirrored), position in the sockets.

action: Sculpts the eyelids around the placed eyeballs.
why: Lids wrap the eyeball, so the ball is placed first.
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes draw along the lid line over the eyeball.

action: Extrudes and models the iris on the eyeball sphere (selected faces in orange on the eye).
why: Narration: extrude and model her iris.
reader_equivalent: bmesh: select the front cap of the eyeball, inset and push in for the iris.

action: Rotates the eyeballs so both look the same way (the iris on the second eye is selected and turned).
why: Narration: rotate her eyes; gives the gaze.
reader_equivalent: Rotate each eyeball object about its centre.

action: Sculpts the eyelashes from a new sphere placed on the lid line.
why: Narration: sculpt her eyelashes using a new sphere.
reader_equivalent: Thin flattened sphere along the upper lid, sculpt_strokes snake_hook for the flick.

action: Gives her a smile: reshapes the mouth corners; radius 35 px, strength 0.344.
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes grab on the mouth corners, small radius.
